title: now_secs.max(0) with explanatory comment is the right narrow fix
description: The .max(0) clamping with an inline comment explaining the exact bypass scenario (negative now_secs bypasses > comparison when not_after_secs also negative) is the right level of fix — it addresses the specific pre-epoch clock case without overengineering a broader clock-rollback defense (which would require a monotonic clock floor, a much larger change). A future contributor should not change this to a bare timestamp() call or 'simplify' by removing the clamp.
